Apple (AAPL) Stock Rating Reaffirmed by Morgan Stanley Posted by Paula Ricardo | Jan 25th, 2018 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) ‘s stock had its “buy” rating reissued by analysts at Morgan Stanley in a research note issued to investors on Tuesday. They presently have a $205.00 price objective on the iPhone maker’s stock, up from their previous price objective of $200.00. Morgan Stanley’s target price would indicate a potential upside of 17.67% from the stock’s previous close. 
Several other equities research analysts have also recently issued reports on AAPL. Barclays set a $174.00 price objective on shares of Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a research report on Thursday, January 18th. Zacks Investment Research cut shares of Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a research report on Monday, January 8th. Mizuho reissued a “neutral” rating and issued a $175.00 price objective (up from $160.00) on shares of Apple in a research report on Friday, January 19th. Rosenblatt Securities reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $180.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Friday, January 19th. Finally, Bank of America reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $180.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, September 26th. One investment analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, twelve have assigned a hold rating, thirty-seven have assigned a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The stock has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $200.81. Get Apple alerts: 
Apple ( AAPL ) opened at $174.22 on Tuesday. The company has a market cap of $894,500.00, a PE ratio of 18.96, a P/E/G ratio of 1.43 and a beta of 1.23. Apple has a fifty-two week low of $120.28 and a fifty-two week high of $180.10. The company has a current ratio of 1.28, a quick ratio of 1.23 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.73. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, November 2nd. The iPhone maker reported $2.07 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, beating the consensus estimate of $1.87 by $0.20. The company had revenue of $52.58 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $50.71 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.09% and a return on equity of 36.29%. The firm’s quarterly revenue was up 12.2% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period in the previous year, the company earned $1.50 EPS. equities analysts predict that Apple will post 11.2 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. 
In related news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of Apple stock in a transaction that occurred on Tuesday, November 14th. The shares were sold at an average price of $172.35, for a total value of $2,695,726.35. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now owns 39,682 shares in the company, valued at $6,839,192.70. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available at the SEC website . Also, insider Eduardo H. Cue sold 65,361 shares of Apple stock in a transaction that occurred on Thursday, November 30th. The shares were sold at an average price of $171.60, for a total transaction of $11,215,947.60. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Over the last quarter, insiders have sold 128,412 shares of company stock valued at $22,115,155. Company insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock.

Dynamic Advisors Solutions LLC now owns 19,859 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,860,000 after acquiring an additional 114 shares during the last quarter. Gibraltar Capital Management Inc. now owns 70,449 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $10,146,000 after acquiring an additional 1,688 shares during the last quarter. RB Capital Management LLC now owns 49,635 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $7,148,000 after acquiring an additional 3,894 shares during the last quarter. Daiwa SB Investments Ltd. now owns 69,000 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $9,937,000 after acquiring an additional 3,480 shares during the last quarter. Hartwell J M Limited Partnership now owns 83,650 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $12,047,000 after acquiring an additional 2,225 shares during the last quarter.
